card.name: No element dividing a sum of three others
card.family: science prize a nondividing k sum

task.name: No element dividing a sum of three others
task.family: science prize a nondividing k sum
task.description: construct() -> 1..maximum=48 distinct positive integers <=n=192. No selected integer may divide the sum of any k=3 DISTINCT OTHER selected integers. Maximize cardinality. This excludes the tested element from the summands. Follow the prize bank’s prescribed-number wording: k=3 distinct OTHER summands in [1,192], at most 48 elements. This relaxes the broader all-subsets condition in Erdős’s survey and is not attributed as his exact original statement.
